19ACombatCharacter::ACombatCharacter()
20{
21 PrimaryActorTick.bCanEverTick = true;
22
23 // bind the attack montage ended delegate
24 OnAttackMontageEnded.BindUObject(this, &ACombatCharacter::AttackMontageEnded);
25
26 // Set size for collision capsule
27 GetCapsuleComponent()->InitCapsuleSize(35.0f, 90.0f);
28
29 // Configure character movement
30 GetCharacterMovement()->MaxWalkSpeed = 400.0f;
31
32 // create the camera boom
33 CameraBoom = CreateDefaultSubobject<USpringArmComponent>(TEXT("CameraBoom"));
34 CameraBoom->SetupAttachment(RootComponent);
35
36 CameraBoom->TargetArmLength = DefaultCameraDistance;
37 CameraBoom->bUsePawnControlRotation = true;
38 CameraBoom->bEnableCameraLag = true;
39 CameraBoom->bEnableCameraRotationLag = true;
40
41 // create the orbiting camera
42 FollowCamera = CreateDefaultSubobject<UCameraComponent>(TEXT("FollowCamera"));
43 FollowCamera->SetupAttachment(CameraBoom, USpringArmComponent::SocketName);
44 FollowCamera->bUsePawnControlRotation = false;
45
46 // create the life bar widget component
47 LifeBar = CreateDefaultSubobject<UWidgetComponent>(TEXT("LifeBar"));
48 LifeBar->SetupAttachment(RootComponent);
49
50 // set the player tag
51 Tags.Add(FName("Player"));
52}

89void ACombatCharacter::DoMove(float Right, float Forward)
90{
91 if (GetController() != nullptr)
92 {
93 // find out which way is forward
94 const FRotator Rotation = GetController()->GetControlRotation();
95 const FRotator YawRotation(0, Rotation.Yaw, 0);
96
97 // get forward vector
98 const FVector ForwardDirection = FRotationMatrix(YawRotation).GetUnitAxis(EAxis::X);
99
100 // get right vector
101 const FVector RightDirection = FRotationMatrix(YawRotation).GetUnitAxis(EAxis::Y);
102
103 // add movement
104 AddMovementInput(ForwardDirection, Forward);
105 AddMovementInput(RightDirection, Right);
106 }
107}

176void ACombatCharacter::ComboAttack()
177{
178 // raise the attacking flag
179 bIsAttacking = true;
180
181 // reset the combo count
182 ComboCount = 0;
183
184 // play the attack montage
185 if (UAnimInstance* AnimInstance = GetMesh()->GetAnimInstance())
186 {
187 const float MontageLength = AnimInstance->Montage_Play(ComboAttackMontage, 1.0f, EMontagePlayReturnType::MontageLength, 0.0f, true);
188
189 // subscribe to montage completed and interrupted events
190 if (MontageLength > 0.0f)
191 {
192 // set the end delegate for the montage
193 AnimInstance->Montage_SetEndDelegate(OnAttackMontageEnded, ComboAttackMontage);
194 }
195 }
196
197}

221void ACombatCharacter::AttackMontageEnded(UAnimMontage* Montage, bool bInterrupted)
222{
223 // reset the attacking flag
224 bIsAttacking = false;
225
226 // check if we have a non-stale cached input
227 if (GetWorld()->GetTimeSeconds() - CachedAttackInputTime <= AttackInputCacheTimeTolerance)
228 {
229 // are we holding the charged attack button?
230 if (bIsChargingAttack)
231 {
232 // do a charged attack
233 ChargedAttack();
234 }
235 else
236 {
237 // do a regular attack
238 ComboAttack();
239 }
240 }
241}

243void ACombatCharacter::DoAttackTrace(FName DamageSourceBone)
244{
245 // sweep for objects in front of the character to be hit by the attack
246 TArray<FHitResult> OutHits;
247
248 // start at the provided socket location, sweep forward
249 const FVector TraceStart = GetMesh()->GetSocketLocation(DamageSourceBone);
250 const FVector TraceEnd = TraceStart + (GetActorForwardVector() * MeleeTraceDistance);
251
252 // check for pawn and world dynamic collision object types
253 FCollisionObjectQueryParams ObjectParams;
254 ObjectParams.AddObjectTypesToQuery(ECC_Pawn);
255 ObjectParams.AddObjectTypesToQuery(ECC_WorldDynamic);
256
257 // use a sphere shape for the sweep
258 FCollisionShape CollisionShape;
259 CollisionShape.SetSphere(MeleeTraceRadius);
260
261 // ignore self
262 FCollisionQueryParams QueryParams;
263 QueryParams.AddIgnoredActor(this);
264
265 if (GetWorld()->SweepMultiByObjectType(OutHits, TraceStart, TraceEnd, FQuat::Identity, ObjectParams, CollisionShape, QueryParams))
266 {
267 // iterate over each object hit
268 for (const FHitResult& CurrentHit : OutHits)
269 {
270 // check if we've hit a damageable actor
271 ICombatDamageable* Damageable = Cast<ICombatDamageable>(CurrentHit.GetActor());
272
273 if (Damageable)
274 {
275 // knock upwards and away from the impact normal
276 const FVector Impulse = (CurrentHit.ImpactNormal * -MeleeKnockbackImpulse) + (FVector::UpVector * MeleeLaunchImpulse);
277
278 // pass the damage event to the actor
279 Damageable->ApplyDamage(MeleeDamage, this, CurrentHit.ImpactPoint, Impulse);
280
281 // call the BP handler to play effects, etc.
282 DealtDamage(MeleeDamage, CurrentHit.ImpactPoint);
283 }
284 }
285 }
286}

288void ACombatCharacter::CheckCombo()
289{
290 // are we playing a non-charge attack animation?
291 if (bIsAttacking && !bIsChargingAttack)
292 {
293 // is the last attack input not stale?
294 if (GetWorld()->GetTimeSeconds() - CachedAttackInputTime <= ComboInputCacheTimeTolerance)
295 {
296 // consume the attack input so we don't accidentally trigger it twice
297 CachedAttackInputTime = 0.0f;
298
299 // increase the combo counter
300 ++ComboCount;
301
302 // do we still have a combo section to play?
303 if (ComboCount < ComboSectionNames.Num())
304 {
305 // jump to the next combo section
306 if (UAnimInstance* AnimInstance = GetMesh()->GetAnimInstance())
307 {
308 AnimInstance->Montage_JumpToSection(ComboSectionNames[ComboCount], ComboAttackMontage);
309 }
310 }
311 }
312 }
313}

315void ACombatCharacter::CheckChargedAttack()
316{
317 // raise the looped charged attack flag
318 bHasLoopedChargedAttack = true;
319
320 // jump to either the loop or the attack section depending on whether we're still holding the charge button
321 if (UAnimInstance* AnimInstance = GetMesh()->GetAnimInstance())
322 {
323 AnimInstance->Montage_JumpToSection(bIsChargingAttack ? ChargeLoopSection : ChargeAttackSection, ChargedAttackMontage);
324 }
325}

327void ACombatCharacter::ApplyDamage(float Damage, AActor* DamageCauser, const FVector& DamageLocation, const FVector& DamageImpulse)
328{
329 // pass the damage event to the actor
330 FDamageEvent DamageEvent;
331 const float ActualDamage = TakeDamage(Damage, DamageEvent, nullptr, DamageCauser);
332
333 // only process knockback and effects if we received nonzero damage
334 if (ActualDamage > 0.0f)
335 {
336 // apply the knockback impulse
337 GetCharacterMovement()->AddImpulse(DamageImpulse, true);
338
339 // is the character ragdolling?
340 if (GetMesh()->IsSimulatingPhysics())
341 {
342 // apply an impulse to the ragdoll
343 GetMesh()->AddImpulseAtLocation(DamageImpulse * GetMesh()->GetMass(), DamageLocation);
344 }
345
346 // pass control to BP to play effects, etc.
347 ReceivedDamage(ActualDamage, DamageLocation, DamageImpulse.GetSafeNormal());
348 }
349
350}

352void ACombatCharacter::HandleDeath()
353{
354 // disable movement while we're dead
355 GetCharacterMovement()->DisableMovement();
356
357 // enable full ragdoll physics
358 GetMesh()->SetSimulatePhysics(true);
359
360 // hide the life bar
361 LifeBar->SetHiddenInGame(true);
362
363 // pull back the camera
364 GetCameraBoom()->TargetArmLength = DeathCameraDistance;
365
366 // schedule respawning
367 GetWorld()->GetTimerManager().SetTimer(RespawnTimer, this, &ACombatCharacter::RespawnCharacter, RespawnTime, false);
368}

381float ACombatCharacter::TakeDamage(float Damage, struct FDamageEvent const& DamageEvent, AController* EventInstigator, AActor* DamageCauser)
382{
383 // only process damage if the character is still alive
384 if (CurrentHP <= 0.0f)
385 {
386 return 0.0f;
387 }
388
389 // reduce the current HP
390 CurrentHP -= Damage;
391
392 // have we run out of HP?
393 if (CurrentHP <= 0.0f)
394 {
395 // die
396 HandleDeath();
397 }
398 else
399 {
400 // update the life bar
401 LifeBarWidget->SetLifePercentage(CurrentHP / MaxHP);
402
403 // enable partial ragdoll physics, but keep the pelvis vertical
404 GetMesh()->SetPhysicsBlendWeight(0.5f);
405 GetMesh()->SetBodySimulatePhysics(PelvisBoneName, false);
406 }
407
408 // return the received damage amount
409 return Damage;
410}

424void ACombatCharacter::BeginPlay()
425{
426 Super::BeginPlay();
427
428 // get the life bar from the widget component
429 LifeBarWidget = Cast<UCombatLifeBar>(LifeBar->GetUserWidgetObject());
430 check(LifeBarWidget);
431
432 // initialize the camera
433 GetCameraBoom()->TargetArmLength = DefaultCameraDistance;
434
435 // save the relative transform for the mesh so we can reset the ragdoll later
436 MeshStartingTransform = GetMesh()->GetRelativeTransform();
437
438 // set the life bar color
439 LifeBarWidget->SetBarColor(LifeBarColor);
440
441 // reset HP to maximum
442 ResetHP();

453void ACombatCharacter::SetupPlayerInputComponent(UInputComponent* PlayerInputComponent)
454{
455 Super::SetupPlayerInputComponent(PlayerInputComponent);
456
457 // Set up action bindings
458 if (UEnhancedInputComponent* EnhancedInputComponent = Cast<UEnhancedInputComponent>(PlayerInputComponent))
459 {
460 // Moving
461 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(MoveAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &ACombatCharacter::Move);
462
463 // Looking
464 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(LookAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &ACombatCharacter::Look);
465 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(MouseLookAction, ETriggerEvent::Triggered, this, &ACombatCharacter::Look);
466
467 // Combo Attack
468 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(ComboAttackAction, ETriggerEvent::Started, this, &ACombatCharacter::ComboAttackPressed);
469
470 // Charged Attack
471 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(ChargedAttackAction, ETriggerEvent::Started, this, &ACombatCharacter::ChargedAttackPressed);
472 EnhancedInputComponent->BindAction(ChargedAttackAction, ETriggerEvent::Completed, this, &ACombatCharacter::ChargedAttackReleased);
473 }
474}
